title: (RHBA-2016:0342) Red Hat Middleware 1.2 Images for OpenShift
portal_summary: Updates are now available for Red Hat Middleware images running in OpenShift 3.1
portal_synopsis: Red Hat Middleware 1.2 Images for OpenShift
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.1|x86_64
portal_solution:
To update to the latest xPaaS images run the following steps to pull in the content

1. On your master host(s), ensure you are logged into the CLI as a cluster administrator or user that has project administrator access to the global "openshift" project. For example:

$ oc login -u system:admin

Then, run the following command to update the core set of OpenShift image streams in the "openshift" project:

$ for is in jboss-webserver30-tomcat7-openshift \
  jboss-webserver30-tomcat8-openshift \
  jboss-eap64-openshift \
  jboss-decisionserver62-openshift \
  jboss-datagrid65-openshift \
  jboss-amq-62 \
  fis-java-openshift \
  fis-karaf-openshift ;
do
  oc -n openshift import-image ${is}
done
portal_description:
Red Hat xPaaS provides images for many of the Red Hat Middleware products for use within the OpenShift Enterprise 3.1 cloud computing Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) for on-premise or private cloud deployments.

The images have been rebuilt using the latest Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) 7.2 base image.  These rebuilt images inherit all bug fixes and improvements currently included in the RHEL 7.2 stream.  No changes have been made to any of the Middleware Products included in these images.

This update includes the following new images

repository: jboss-amq-6/amq62-openshift
tags: 1.2-14,1.2,latest
—
repository: jboss-webserver-3/webserver30-tomcat7-openshift
tags: 1.2-12,1.2,latest
—
repository: jboss-webserver-3/webserver30-tomcat8-openshift
tags: 1.2-12,1.2,latest
—
repository: jboss-eap-6/eap64-openshift
tags: 1.2-20,1.2,latest
—
repository: jboss-datagrid-6/datagrid65-openshift
tags: 1.2-19,1.2,latest
—
repository: jboss-decisionserver-6/decisionserver62-openshift
tags: 1.2-18,1.2,latest
—
repository: jboss-fuse-6/fis-karaf-openshift
tags: 1.0-11,1.0,latest
—
repository: jboss-fuse-6/fis-java-openshift
tags: 1.0-11,1.0,latest

OpenShift Enterprise 3.1 users can upgrade to these updated images.
